scope: Static public-source evidence, one anonymous GetPayConfig probe, and isolated remote synthetic verification. No third-party bundle execution, credential or private account-data access, real order creation, or payment.

implementation.verification_provenance: Isolated synthetic execution through ssh test-env. Artifact paths are relative to this document; each report records its source scope.

covered_cases: Default recharge mutation cannot be preempted or replayed
Timeout and transport failure do not retry creation
Close preserves a previously read receipt
Close drains an unread complete receipt after stopping the child
Mismatched task, attempt, and oversized frames remain rejected
Oversized payment URLs are retained without truncated QR encoding
Definite pre-submission rejection is distinguished from uncertain creation

get_config.body_note: The facade supplies url and response model type only; no data field is set in this method.

anonymous_probe.established: Anonymous access was rejected; no authenticated configuration or live accepted amount was established.

raw_fields.pay_amount_ranges: Array of recharge-option objects, mapped to amountConfig

option_raw_fields.pay_amount: Number in yuan, mapped to payAmount

custom_amount_policy.explicit_config_policy: Not present in the observed model
custom_amount_policy.source_observation: freeChargeRMB names and a watcher exist, but no currently rendered custom input or min/max/step contract was established.
custom_amount_policy.plugin_policy: A manually entered amount is accepted only when it matches an official preset from fresh configuration.

create_order.response_note: Static model tracing confirms raw pay_params maps to typed data.payParams. The JSON string contains codeUrl and orderId; the wrapper extracts the decimal order ID as text to preserve exact precision. No authenticated wire response was captured.
create_order.separate_generic_model: DRno.Ql maps raw pay_params:String and order_id:String; the QR wrapper instead selects /QaS.p.

qr_display.flow: Save response.orderId, set process to recharging, call qrPanelVM.createQrCode(response.codeUrl), then start polling.
qr_display.renderer: The web QR component passes codeUrl unchanged to a lazily loaded qrcode module toCanvas(canvas, codeUrl, errorCallback); the plugin uses QRWidget.
qr_display.channel_note: One QR supports both advertised scanning applications in the observed web flow; live channel availability was not tested.

history.response_shape: The response body's data is the order array itself, without an orders or list container.

raw_fields.free_gold: Number, mapped to freeGold; the UI labels this as a manga-coin deduction-card bonus

history.status_note: The history model has no order-status field. The HTTP wrapper's status is an HTTP status and must not be treated as payment status.

poll.match_note: The observed web flow matches exact IDs without a separate order-status filter.

implementation_safeguards: Preserve exact decimal order IDs as strings.
Accept QR destinations only under the strict https://pay.bilibili.com/ URL boundary.
Check the selected option fingerprint against freshly loaded official configuration before creation.
Accept a manually entered amount only when it matches a current official preset.
Require an explicit user action for order creation and never automatically retry CreateOrder.
Preserve complete validated recharge worker receipts across timeout or teardown, with a bounded pipe drain and unchanged task/attempt checks.
Keep creation separate from polling, and do not infer success from a balance change or the unknown history pay_amount unit.
Do not infer expiry from elapsed time, a missing history match, or the separate payment SDK.
Closing a QR view does not cancel an outstanding order.
reachability: The RechargeOption order-create event is bound to doRecharge when TabKey is empty. The same panel displays the QR view while process is recharging.
limits: The protocol, service, controller, worker, runner, and UI passed remote synthetic verification.
Remote synthetic verification does not establish a successful real account order or payment.
The anonymous GetPayConfig POST {} returned HTTP 401 without credentials; authenticated session behavior and live configuration remain unverified.
Accepted live amounts, server expiry, channel availability, and settlement behavior remain unverified.
The investigation did not establish a currently rendered arbitrary-amount input or an explicit custom-amount policy.
The separate Bilibili pay SDK cashier flow and its expiry are not asserted to be required by the manga QR CreateOrder path.
Source-confirmed model mappings are not authenticated wire-response captures or an externally supported API contract.
